tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Modular utilities for conversion, audio analysis, speech recognition, slicing, merging, and vocal-to-MIDI transcription.
tools.convertDescription: Convert audio files in batches while normalizing sample rate, channels, and encoding quality.
tools.folderScanned: Added {count} audio file(s) from the folder
tools.folderEmpty: The selected folder contains no supported audio files
tools.folderAlreadyAdded: All audio files in the folder have already been added
tools.folderScanWarnings: Folder scan completed with {count} unreadable path(s)
tools.convertHint: Output names include the sample rate and encoding quality. Existing files are preserved by assigning a new name.
tools.mergeDescription: Order the audio files in a directory using a selected rule and export a normalized WAV file.
tools.mergeRegexHelp: Use Python regular-expression syntax. The first capture group is used as the sort value; without one, the full match is used. Unmatched files remain last.
tools.mergeRegexRequired: Enter a regular expression that extracts the sort value
tools.mergeNameHint: Filenames use natural ordering, so 2 is placed before 10.
tools.mergeModifiedHint: Files are concatenated by last modified time, with filename ordering used for stable ties.
tools.mergeRegexHint: The expression is applied to the full filename. Matches use natural ordering and unmatched files always remain last.
tools.mergeHint: Inputs with different formats, sample rates, or channel layouts are normalized before concatenation.
tools.sdrDescription: Align reference and estimated audio, then calculate per-channel SDR and SI-SDR.
tools.sdrHint: Both inputs are aligned at 44.1 kHz and truncated to the duration of the shorter input.
tools.sdrResultHint: Higher values generally indicate a closer match to the reference audio.
tools.midiDescription: Use GAME's native Torch model to extract pitch and note durations from vocal audio.
tools.midiModelChooseHint: Choose a GAME model file from the extracted archive
tools.midiModelHint: Extract a GAME v1.0 model archive and select model.pt. Keep config.yaml and lang_map.json in the same directory.
tools.midiModelExtensionError: Choose model.pt from a GAME model archive

tools.midiAccuracyHint: Use a dry, isolated solo vocal when possible. The generated MIDI will usually need manual correction.
tools.midiHint: Inference uses the accelerator available in the active runtime. Initial model loading may take some time.
tools.noActivityLog: Processing events will appear here after a task starts
tools.phaseDetailStarted: The {tool} task was submitted and is waiting for the worker.
tools.phaseDetailPreparing: Validating inputs, the output directory, and task parameters.

tools.phaseDetailNormalizing: Normalizing sample rate, channels, and encoding format.

tools.phaseDetailLoadingEstimated: Loading the estimated audio and aligning channels.
tools.phaseDetailCalculating: Audio is ready; calculating SDR and SI-SDR metrics.
tools.phaseDetailLoadingModel: Loading the GAME configuration and weights onto the runtime device. The first run may take longer.
tools.phaseDetailLoadingAudio: The model is ready; decoding audio and detecting active vocal segments.
tools.phaseDetailTranscribing: Inferring note boundaries, pitch, and pronunciation for each segment.
tools.phaseDetailWritingOutput: Inference is complete; normalizing notes and writing the MIDI file.

tools.inspectDescription: Inspect containers, audio streams, encoding parameters, and metadata with FFprobe.

tools.slicerHint: Silence is analyzed before segments are exported from the source. Existing files are preserved.

tools.asrDescription: Generate text, timestamps, and subtitles with a selectable FunASR recognition profile.

tools.asrPresetParaformerEnDescription: For English speech and long-form transcription, with VAD and bilingual punctuation.
tools.asrPresetSenseVoiceDescription: Supports Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and Cantonese, including emotion and audio-event information.
tools.asrPresetNanoDescription: For Chinese, English, Japanese, Chinese dialects, and lyrics over background music.
tools.asrPresetMltNanoDescription: For 31-language and mixed-language recognition across multilingual media.
tools.chooseAsrModel: Choose a local FunASR model directory

tools.asrAuxUsesPreset: Missing auxiliary models will be downloaded automatically on first use.

tools.asrHotwordsUnavailable: The selected recognition profile does not use hotwords
tools.asrFormatRequired: Select at least one output format
tools.asrWarningNoTimestamps: The model returned no valid timestamps, so an SRT file was not generated.

tools.phaseDetailAnalyzingSilence: Decoding an analysis stream and detecting eligible silence intervals.
tools.phaseDetailWritingSegments: Cut points are ready; exporting audio segments from the source file.
tools.phaseDetailLoadingAsrModel: Loading ASR, VAD, and punctuation models. The initial download may take some time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage appearance, language, runtime environment, and default paths.

onboarding.languageDescription: You can lock a language now or let the app follow the system language automatically.
onboarding.themeDescription: The theme mode applies immediately and can still be changed later in Settings.
onboarding.accentDescription: Pick the accent palette you prefer and the whole app will update instantly.
onboarding.runtimeDescription: Select the backend for this computer. The online package installs the required fixed versions now.
onboarding.runtimeCpu: Broadest compatibility and no GPU driver required.
onboarding.runtimeCuda: For NVIDIA GPUs with a compatible CUDA driver.
onboarding.runtimeRocm: For supported AMD GPUs on Windows 11 with the matching driver.
onboarding.runtimeMlx: For Apple Silicon devices using MLX acceleration.
onboarding.runtimeMirrorHint: The selected PyPI mirror is used for general dependencies only; PyTorch CUDA/ROCm installation falls back to the official PyTorch repository.
onboarding.runtimeDriverHint: GPU backends require a compatible driver. CPU mode remains available if installation or hardware checks fail.
onboarding.runtimeAlreadyReady: The selected environment is already installed; it will just be switched to, with nothing to download.
onboarding.runtimeDetecting: Detecting the runtime environment shipped with this package.
onboarding.dataDirDescription: Confirm the model directory and default output directory. You can change them separately later in Settings.
onboarding.dataDirReady: Default directories are saved persistently and can be changed in Settings.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.subtitle: Create and manage pymss workflows, and use the node editor to design separation graphs.
workflows.createTypeDescription: Simple and advanced workflows use independent editors and data structures. Choose the best starting point for this task.
workflows.createSimpleDescription: Configure models, input sources, and output stems in a guided step editor for common sequential separation flows.
workflows.createAdvancedDescription: Freely combine input, separation, audio processing, and save nodes for complex graphs. This editor is still being refined.
workflows.noStemPorts: Choose a model to expose output stems
workflows.simpleEditorHint: Drag any input or output port to reconnect; double-click empty space to add a separation step; click an edge to disconnect it.
workflows.dropStemToSave: Drop a stem here to save it

simpleConnection.invalidSource: This output port is no longer available.
simpleConnection.forwardLink: A step can only use output from an earlier step.
simpleConnection.selfLink: A step cannot connect to itself.
simpleConnection.invalidSaveTarget: Only a step output can be saved.

workflows.graphEditorFormatRequired: This record is not an advanced graph workflow. Open it with the simple workflow editor instead.
workflows.advancedWarningTitle: Advanced workflows are still in development
workflows.advancedWarningContent: The advanced node editor currently has known stability issues. Prefer the simple workflow editor when possible, and continue only when simple mode cannot cover the workflow you need.
workflows.advancedModeRequired: This workflow contains settings that the simple editor cannot modify.
workflows.simpleEditUnsupported: This workflow contains settings that the simple editor cannot modify.
workflows.simpleReasonGraphWorkflow: This workflow already uses the node graph format.
workflows.simpleReasonAdvancedParameters: Contains per-step parameters, custom models, or other settings the simple editor cannot preserve losslessly.
workflows.simpleReasonInvalidDefinition: The workflow definition format is invalid.
workflows.emptyDesc: Create a workflow, then configure its separation graph in the node editor.
workflows.name: Name
workflows.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the expected input and output for this workflow.
workflows.notePlaceholder: Add a workflow note, for example: useful for vocal enhancement or batch processing.
workflows.revisionConflictHint: “{name}” was modified after this editor opened. Choose how to resolve the newer version.
workflows.deleteHint: Delete “{name}”? Generated results will not be removed.
workflows.workflowImportInvalid: The file does not contain a valid simple or advanced graph workflow definition
workflows.stepInputPlaceholder: Choose original input or a previous stem
workflows.saveStemsPlaceholder: Connect a stem to the Save node to write a file (unconnected stems can still flow)
workflows.stepsRequired: At least one step is required.
workflows.stepStemsRequired: Step “{id}” needs at least one output stem.
workflows.stepModelNotDownloaded: The model for {id} is not downloaded. Download it from the Models page first.
workflows.nodeEditorOpenedHint: This workflow is open in the standalone node editor. Complete and save changes there to prevent configuration conflicts.
workflows.workflowNoSaveOutputs: The workflow has no valid saved output. Configure an output directory or save node for at least one stem.
workflows.workflowFormatInvalid: The workflow definition format is invalid.
workflows.overviewEmptyDesc: Pick a workflow from the list to edit it, or create a new one.
workflows.comfyReadOnlyHint: Advanced (comfy) workflows are free-form; this page shows a read-only overview. Edit the graph in the advanced editor; the inference page uses the shared input-file list.
